reason: Serves the node's TLS certificate, which exists only when the server runs with TLS. The SDK e2e nodes serve plain HTTP, so the route can only answer 404 there; the admin sweep pins that 404.

Retries an upgrade whose propagator left contexts failed. No e2e node can make a context fail an upgrade on purpose, so a success cannot be arranged; the admin sweep pins the 404 (no upgrade) and 409 (nothing to retry) answers.
